scope: global closed-sphere continuum; one model; zero fault elements; no prescribed velocity boundary records

partition.support_use: runtime-only plate assignment outline generation; no boundary-type or motion semantics

parameter_reference.purpose: single-run solver smoke values only; no Earth geometry, boundary conditions, observations, or plate motions are staged

solver.gauge_policy: NO_GAUGE_IN_INITIAL_RUN; if source reports singularity, classify rigid-rotation nullspace and run only the separately identified minimal engineering gauge diagnostic

reproducibility_tolerance.classification: engineering output comparison policy; not a scientific acceptance tolerance

list_input_override.note: The stock example has the same value; the explicit one-variable List run exercises the ShellSet input path.

parameter_binding_audit.interpretation: ShellSet's input schema requires a complete reference parameter record. These values permit an engineering solver attempt only; they do not establish an ARCANA material, thermal, rheological, or planetary authority.
